senses.zh_definition: 丹妮丝，通常用作女性名字的外来专名。
senses.en_definition: Denise, a given name usually borne by women.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas peribadi yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama perempuan.
senses.nuances: 此处 pos 的 noun 指专有名词。它不是已由所给资料确认的普通马来词，因此不标为 official；马来语释义是本条的解释性释义，并非 DBP 原文。以下是姓名搭配示例，不是固定词组。[Collins：Denise](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/denise)

dual_scenarios.ms: Denise akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 丹妮丝将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Denise will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

spoken_features: 句末 ke 表示询问。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Denise, awak dah makan ke? Saya nak turun makan sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Denise, adakah awak sudah makan? Saya hendak turun untuk makan sekarang.
messages.zh: 丹妮丝，你吃了吗？我现在想下楼吃饭。
messages.en: Denise, have you eaten yet? I'm heading downstairs for lunch now.

messages.speaker: Denise (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Tunggu saya kat lobi, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya belum makan. Tunggu saya di lobi, ya.
messages.zh: 还没呢。在大堂等我一下啊。
messages.en: Not yet. Wait for me in the lobby, okay?

etymology.historical_story: Denise belongs to a European personal-name tradition rather than a Malay word family. It is the French feminine counterpart of Denis, related to English Dennis. Medieval records document Denise in France and related forms elsewhere. Its appearance in Malay sentences reflects people being named and addressed, rather than the creation of a new Malay common noun. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/denise), [Dictionary of Medieval Names](https://dmnes.org/2015/3/name/Denise)
